chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 504: Broken Diagram vs Supreme Ancestral Gods
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen confronts three Supreme Ancestral Gods with the broken formation diagram, survives a near-fatal blow, and returns to the mortal world fused with Eternal Light. A pivotal chapter in his climb to the highest realms.
